## Checklist

- [ ] This PR adds **exactly one** new `skills/<name>/` folder and nothing else.
- [ ] The folder name matches the `name` in `SKILL.md` frontmatter (lowercase, `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 64 chars, no `anthropic`/`claude`).
- [ ] `description` states **what it does and when to use it** (≤ 1024 chars).
- [ ] `SKILL.md` has an `## Instructions` and an `## Examples` section.
- [ ] It's a skill I'd personally recommend — no secrets, no employer internals.
- [ ] I ran the validator locally: `python .github/scripts/validate_skill.py` (optional but appreciated).
